title: Reduction for a First or Second Rush in Twelve Months — PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
**Rule.** In the PAP Supply Replenishment Program a first rush is softened by an amount taken off the rush charge:

- **1.00** is taken off when the enrollment shows no expedited shipping charge in the last 12 months;
- **0.50** when it shows exactly one;
- otherwise nothing.

The amount is taken off after the share of the priced rush is applied, and the charge never goes below zero.

## Counting

Expedited shipping-charge lines on the enrollment whose date is fewer than 12 whole calendar months before today.

| Expedited shipping charges in the last 12 months | Taken off |
|---|---|
| 0 | 1.00 |
| 1 | 0.50 |
| 2 or more | nothing |

## Examples (hypothetical)

- No earlier rush in the last 12 months, rush otherwise 9.95: 9.95 less 1.00 is 8.95.
- One rush 5 months ago: 9.95 less 0.50 is 9.45.
- A rush 14 months ago and none since: it falls outside the 12 months, so 1.00 is taken off.
